header: === ORCHESTRATION GUARD (you are one of several agents running CONCURRENTLY) ===
rule: Do NOT run a single-flight tool: one that allows only one process per machine or per checkout, such as a game engine or a language server. Your delegate rails name this project's others; a build, typecheck or test command they do not name is not single-flight, so run your brief's own checks with it. Python and Node proofs under .claude/tests/ are not single-flight
withShell: ; run the edited unit's proof file, not harness_tests.py (its machine slots are shared; rules/harness_tooling.md).
noShell: ; you have no shell, so cite a proof by path instead of running it.
stop: If your task file mandates a single-flight run, STOP and report that it needs a serialized dispatch.
